question: Identify the state abbreviations where, for both male and female legislators, the retention rate remains greater than zero at specific intervals of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 years after their first term start date. A legislator is considered retained if they are serving on December 31 of the respective year. Only include states where both gender cohorts maintain non-zero retention rates at all six of these time points during the first decade of service.
sql:
WITH first_terms AS (
    SELECT l.id_bioguide, l.gender, lt.state, CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) as first_term_start
    FROM legislators l
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    WHERE lt.term_number = 0
),
target_dates AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, gender, state, first_term_start,
           EXTRACT(YEAR FROM first_term_start) + 0 as target_year_0,
           EXTRACT(YEAR FROM first_term_start) + 2 as target_year_2,
           EXTRACT(YEAR FROM first_term_start) + 4 as target_year_4,
           EXTRACT(YEAR FROM first_term_start) + 6 as target_year_6,
           EXTRACT(YEAR FROM first_term_start) + 8 as target_year_8,
           EXTRACT(YEAR FROM first_term_start) + 10 as target_year_10,
           DATE(CONCAT(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM first_term_start) + 0 AS VARCHAR), '-12-31')) as check_date_0,
           DATE(CONCAT(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM first_term_start) + 2 AS VARCHAR), '-12-31')) as check_date_2,
           DATE(CONCAT(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM first_term_start) + 4 AS VARCHAR), '-12-31')) as check_date_4,
           DATE(CONCAT(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM first_term_start) + 6 AS VARCHAR), '-12-31')) as check_date_6,
           DATE(CONCAT(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM first_term_start) + 8 AS VARCHAR), '-12-31')) as check_date_8,
           DATE(CONCAT(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM first_term_start) + 10 AS VARCHAR), '-12-31')) as check_date_10
    FROM first_terms
),
retention AS (
    SELECT td.id_bioguide, td.gender, td.state,
           CASE WHEN EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt
               WHERE lt.id_bioguide = td.id_bioguide
               AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= td.check_date_0
               AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) > td.check_date_0
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained_0,
           CASE WHEN EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt
               WHERE lt.id_bioguide = td.id_bioguide
               AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= td.check_date_2
               AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) > td.check_date_2
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained_2,
           CASE WHEN EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt
               WHERE lt.id_bioguide = td.id_bioguide
               AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= td.check_date_4
               AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) > td.check_date_4
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained_4,
           CASE WHEN EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt
               WHERE lt.id_bioguide = td.id_bioguide
               AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= td.check_date_6
               AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) > td.check_date_6
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained_6,
           CASE WHEN EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt
               WHERE lt.id_bioguide = td.id_bioguide
               AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= td.check_date_8
               AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) > td.check_date_8
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained_8,
           CASE WHEN EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt
               WHERE lt.id_bioguide = td.id_bioguide
               AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= td.check_date_10
               AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) > td.check_date_10
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained_10
    FROM target_dates td
),
retention_rates AS (
    SELECT state, gender,
           SUM(retained_0) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) as rate_0,
           SUM(retained_2) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) as rate_2,
           SUM(retained_4) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) as rate_4,
           SUM(retained_6) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) as rate_6,
           SUM(retained_8) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) as rate_8,
           SUM(retained_10) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) as rate_10
    FROM retention
    GROUP BY state, gender
),
male_rates AS (
    SELECT state,
           MAX(CASE WHEN gender = 'M' THEN rate_0 END) as m_rate_0,
           MAX(CASE WHEN gender = 'M' THEN rate_2 END) as m_rate_2,
           MAX(CASE WHEN gender = 'M' THEN rate_4 END) as m_rate_4,
           MAX(CASE WHEN gender = 'M' THEN rate_6 END) as m_rate_6,
           MAX(CASE WHEN gender = 'M' THEN rate_8 END) as m_rate_8,
           MAX(CASE WHEN gender = 'M' THEN rate_10 END) as m_rate_10
    FROM retention_rates
    GROUP BY state
),
female_rates AS (
    SELECT state,
           MAX(CASE WHEN gender = 'F' THEN rate_0 END) as f_rate_0,
           MAX(CASE WHEN gender = 'F' THEN rate_2 END) as f_rate_2,
           MAX(CASE WHEN gender = 'F' THEN rate_4 END) as f_rate_4,
           MAX(CASE WHEN gender = 'F' THEN rate_6 END) as f_rate_6,
           MAX(CASE WHEN gender = 'F' THEN rate_8 END) as f_rate_8,
           MAX(CASE WHEN gender = 'F' THEN rate_10 END) as f_rate_10
    FROM retention_rates
    GROUP BY state
),
combined AS (
    SELECT m.state, m.m_rate_0, m.m_rate_2, m.m_rate_4, m.m_rate_6, m.m_rate_8, m.m_rate_10,
           f.f_rate_0, f.f_rate_2, f.f_rate_4, f.f_rate_6, f.f_rate_8, f.f_rate_10
    FROM male_rates m
    JOIN female_rates f ON m.state = f.state
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as qualifying_states
FROM combined
WHERE m_rate_0 > 0 AND m_rate_2 > 0 AND m_rate_4 > 0 AND m_rate_6 > 0 AND m_rate_8 > 0 AND m_rate_10 > 0
  AND f_rate_0 > 0 AND f_rate_2 > 0 AND f_rate_4 > 0 AND f_rate_6 > 0 AND f_rate_8 > 0 AND f_rate_10 > 0
